_meta.description: Target queries for the weekly AI-engine visibility (share-of-voice) audit across 5 engines. Tracks whether WorkHive is cited/mentioned/recommended when users ask these questions. V2 re-strategization (2026-08-03): the set now includes DEMAND queries whose expected_cite is NOT yet a WorkHive URL — real buyer language across category, competitor-comparison, head-term calculator, buyer-intent, and PH-local intent. These measure real demand + the competitive gap, not just 'do engines cite the page I already wrote'. `demand_gap: true` marks a query WorkHive does not yet win (the honest baseline gap); `competitors` lists who currently does. Engines synced to geo_sov_audit.py ENGINES.
